description:
Save Time With Rubber Stamp Printing

UPrinting's self-inking rubber stamps are the perfect way to save time when processing documents or mailings. Personalize your own to easily affix names, signatures, certifications, quality assurance stamps, and more. Anyone who handles these tasks on a regular basis knows what a time-saver this creates, especially when working on routine tasks like paying bills or addressing envelopes.

Create your own text:

  • Small stamp: 4 lines of text maximum
  • Medium stamp: 5 lines of text maximum
  • Large stamp: 6 lines of text maximum
  • X-Large: 7 lines of text maximum
  • Square: 9 lines of text maximum
  • Round: 9 lines of text maximum

Custom rubber stamps are available in three sizes and come with black ink.
